description: As a passenger, I want to sign in securely, so that I can access my own luggage claims.
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials allow access; invalid credentials are rejected; passengers cannot read another passenger's claims.

description: As a passenger, I want to submit my flight, baggage tag and contact details, so that I can report a missing bag.
acceptance_criteria: Required fields are validated; a valid submission creates a unique claim reference; the passenger sees confirmation.

description: As a passenger, I want to view my submitted claims and their status, so that I can check the progress of my reports.
acceptance_criteria: Only the signed-in passenger's claims are listed; each shows its reference and current status; an empty list is handled.

description: As a baggage agent, I want to access the agent dashboard using my assigned role, so that I can manage claims securely.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized agent can open the dashboard; a passenger cannot access agent actions; unauthorized requests are rejected.

description: As a baggage agent, I want to search scan records by baggage tag, so that I can locate a reported missing bag.
acceptance_criteria: An existing tag returns ordered scan records; an unknown tag shows no results; each scan shows location and time.

description: As a baggage agent, I want to update a claim as its bag is located and returned, so that I can keep the passenger informed.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized agents can update status; invalid transitions are rejected; the change records the agent and timestamp.

description: As a passenger, I want to view the tracking timeline of my bag, so that I can see its last known location.
acceptance_criteria: The timeline shows available scans in time order; unavailable tracking is explained; access is restricted to the claim owner.

description: As a passenger, I want to receive a notification when my claim status changes, so that I can learn about updates without repeatedly checking.
acceptance_criteria: A status change queues a notification for the claim owner; delivery failures are recorded for retry; duplicate handling avoids repeated messages for the same update.

description: As a passenger, I want to attach supporting documents to my claim, so that I can provide the details needed to process it.
acceptance_criteria: The claim owner can attach a supported file; oversized or unsupported files are rejected; other passengers cannot access the attachment.

description: As a passenger, I want to submit a compensation request for an eligible claim, so that I can request reimbursement for my loss.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility is checked; a valid request receives a reference and pending status; a duplicate request for the same claim is rejected.
